title: Independent TD-DFT characterization of acetylide-localized Ir(III) triplets
difficulty_reasons: Two fixed complexes require coupled ground-state validation, singlet/triplet state calculations, and orbital-character analysis.
The author hypothesis is qualitative and must be tested without prescribing the winning state assignment.

data.description: Complete SI geometries: H 65 atoms/C31H23N6F4Ir; CN 66 atoms/C32H22N7F4Ir.

required_deliverables.description: Validated per-complex energies, orbital assignments, evidence, conclusion, and bounded-failure information.
